lessons.claim: In any entity-resolution pipeline, block cross-category matches deterministically before fuzzy or LLM matching — string similarity must never cross a semantic category boundary.

Never set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in global machine environment variables on a box that runs Claude Code under a subscription — it silently switches billing to API rates; secrets live in per-project .env files.
evidence: STATE.md environment notes (global key found and removed)
lessons.note: Classifier suggested global; interview overrode to stack:claude-code — the rule is tooling-specific.

lessons.claim: When a product's primary output is a recommendation, validate that users would actually act on it before building optimization machinery for it.
evidence: v2 pivot commit history (basket split -> single-store verdict)
